title: Transforms for LLM Quantization: The Great Inversion and Format Co-Design
abstract: arXiv:2608.25188v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most competitive 4-bit LLM research pipelines now open the same way: apply a linear, function-preserving transform (rotation, scaling, permutation, non-orthogonal affine) so the outlier mass sits more favorably against the group scales, and only then round. Yet we are aware of no survey dedicated to this transform stage, and its literature is quietly re-deriving an older theory. We identify and formalize the principle that organizes it, the Great Inversion: allocation-flexible coding rewards energy concentration, whereas the grouped shared-scale quantization a deployed matrix instruction performs rewards within-group flattening. Classical transform coding (1963: decorrelate, allocate bits, quantize) spends different bits per coordinate at a fixed total rate; for a Gaussian source at high rate the Karhunen-Loeve transform's concentration minimizes distortion. translated_title: 大语言模型量化中的变换：大反转与格式协同设计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25188v1 公告类型：新 摘要：目前最具竞争力的4位大语言模型研究流程大多以相同方式开始：应用线性、保持功能的变换（如旋转、缩放、置换、非正交仿射），使异常值质量更有利于分组缩放，然后才进行舍入。然而，我们注意到没有专门针对这一变换阶段的综述，其文献正在悄然重新推导一个较老的理论。我们识别并形式化了组织该理论的原则，即“大反转”：分配灵活的编码奖励能量集中，而部署的矩阵指令所执行的分组共享缩放量化则奖励组内平坦化。经典变换编码（1963年：去相关、分配比特、量化）在固定总速率下为每个坐标分配不同比特；对于高斯源在高速率下，Karhunen-Loeve变换的集中性最小化失真。部署的操作数瓦片则每组携带一个绝对最大缩放值。
tldr: 本文首次系统化总结了LLM量化中变换阶段的核心原理——“大反转”，并强调格式与变换的协同设计，以优化量化性能。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically formalizes the "Great Inversion" principle underlying transform stages in LLM quantization, emphasizing format-transform co-design for improved quantization performance.
